beats.headline: Denmark deserved more
say: Denmark one, Portugal nil at Parken. A late winner, and on the numbers, it should have been more.

beats.title: Schmeichel
beats.text: Keeps out Pedro Neto's long-range shot
say: Early on, Kasper Schmeichel kept out Pedro Neto's long-range shot.

beats.title: Penalty saved
beats.text: Veiga handles. Eriksen's kick, saved by Diogo Costa
say: Then the big chance. Renato Veiga handled, but Diogo Costa saved Christian Eriksen's penalty.

beats.title: Højlund
beats.text: On at 69 minutes, the winner at 78. Assist: Andreas Skov Olsen
say: Højlund came on at sixty-nine minutes, and nine minutes later he scored the winner.
Twenty-three shots to eight. Nine on target to two.
Expected goals: 1.29 to 0.51. Portugal had the ball, Denmark had the chances.

rows.name: Diogo Costa
rows.note: Saved a penalty, kept it at 1–0

say: Our ratings: Højlund and Diogo Costa the standouts. Eriksen, the penalty that got away.

beats.quote: It's the worst match we've played in a very long time. Denmark were simply better than us in every aspect.
say: Portugal's coach, Roberto Martínez, didn't hide from it.

beats.title: What came next
points: Lisbon: Portugal 5–2 Denmark after extra time
Portugal through 5–3 on aggregate, then Germany in the semi-final
say: Three days later in Lisbon, Portugal won five two after extra time.
They went through five three on aggregate.

beats.next: Match analysis before every big game
say: That's the review. Follow for more football, by the numbers.
